items.headline: A site that sells one supplement.
items.text: Dr. Stoykov's site has no services — it has Deflamax. The visitor needs to understand the product and order it, without a clinic menu or appointment booking.

items.headline: A site that brings people to the store door.
items.text: There is no online shop, and there will not be one. The site shows what is in the store now, where it is on Targovska 60, and when it is open. The owner updates collections and sales himself — in Bulgarian, without a developer.
